verdict.rationale: LegalZoom documents its own online corporation formation service, covering S and C corps, investor-friendly stock issuance, and government filing with error correction. That covers the filing step. Nothing in the pack mentions Delaware specifically, corporate bylaws, or initial board consents/resolutions. The AI meeting-minutes feature belongs to annual compliance and is only adjacent. missing for 10: Delaware-specific incorporation evidence, bylaws generation, initial board approvals/organizational resolutions, independent corroboration of the corporation flow.
